mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend (3-month change) remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in periods with declining FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% in a 3-month window, or Rank IC for UNRATE threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS does not yield negative Rank IC (below -0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both series decline.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0, which signals a contraction in manufacturing output, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise and corporate profits fall.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when INDPRO falls below 110.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO threshold signal is below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the past 3 months increases inflation expectations, leading to higher real interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for CPIAUCSL trend (3-month change) is above -0.05 over any 5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods with rising CPI.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC for RSAFS growth signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that drives wage inflation and corporate cost pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between PAYEMS and UNRATE does not yield negative Rank IC (below -0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both series move in expected directions.

mechanism_narrative: During periods when the federal funds rate is above 3.0% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces liquidity and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is above 3.0% and rising, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS tightening signal is below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
